definition: A pack of a room's own ratios in plan and section, taking the room's breadth — its short side — as the module from which its length and height are proportioned.
basis: Our wording of the pack schema's room-system kind and the modules its two packs name. schema/proportion-pack.schema.json, kind description: "room-system: plan and section ratios."; proportions/systems/room-harmonic.json module.name: "The short dimension of the room in plan - its breadth - from which the length and then the height are both generated"; proportions/systems/room-vernacular.json module.name: "The short dimension of the room as built: one clear joist span from bearing wall to bearing wall".
